lines.q: Forty questions. If you get thirty right, your IQ is above average. How many sides does a hexagon have?
lines.a: Six! Just like a honeycomb cell.

lines.q: Which animal is called the King of the Jungle?
lines.a: The lion! Even though lions live on the savanna.

lines.a: The Sun! It's a star too.

lines.q: Who wrote Oliver Twist?
lines.a: Charles Dickens! Please, sir, I want some more.

lines.q: Which bird is a symbol of peace?
Which country gave the United States the Statue of Liberty?
lines.a: France! A gift from eighteen eighty-six.

lines.a: Jupiter! Over a thousand Earths would fit inside.

lines.q: Which language has the most native speakers?
lines.a: Mandarin Chinese! English wins only with learners.

lines.q: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
lines.a: A U! From the Latin aurum.
